_: Every environment-variable name observed in real generator output, captured rather than
invented. A hand-written fixture agrees with whoever wrote it; only real output disagrees
when the generator changes — which is the failure this whole package exists to prevent.

ignored.AWS_AUTOSCALING_GROUP_NAME_0: infrastructure: a scaling group is not a destination for a message
ignored.AWS_DB_INSTANCE_USER_NAME_0: not a name: the value is a Secrets Manager reference (<arn>:username::, the form an ECS task reads); the module reads the username out of SECRET_ARN instead
ignored.AWS_EFS_ACCESS_POINT_NAME_0: blocked: POSIX writes need the filesystem mounted
ignored.AWS_EFS_FILE_SYSTEM_ID_0: blocked: POSIX writes need the filesystem mounted
ignored.AWS_KMS_KEY_NAME_0: infrastructure: a key encrypts other wires, it receives nothing
ignored.AWS_SERVICE_DISCOVERY_SERVICE_NAME_0: blocked: needs discovery to resolve a target
ignored.AWS_SUBNET_NAME_0: infrastructure: a subnet is not a destination for a message
